integrity: Infinite-parameter proof via exact facet enumeration, contractible pieces, and pair exact sequence; independent exhaustive finite checks for \(2\le n\le7\). This is not an independent audit or external validation.
scientific_limitations: Only one-dimensional \(K_{2,n}\) with \(n\ge3\); no classification for larger left bipartition. The \(n=2\) cycle endpoint is previously studied. Relevant 2026 preprint could not be re-opened beyond its available first six pages, leaving literature-completeness risk.
title: Strong Morse matching complexes of \(K_{2,n}\): a bridge decomposition and equivariant homology
